# What works, and what does not

Source in, an arm64 Mach-O object out, linked against `native/gc/runtime.c` and executed.
JavaScript semantics live in `lib/**/*.jsl`; the compiler lowers syntax into calls on them
and owns no meaning of its own.

Every number below is COUNTED when this file is generated, and the file is compared byte
for byte on every gate. Nothing here is maintained by hand -- a hand-maintained status
page is what rotted last time: `repros/open/` held four bug files whose runner had been
deleted, and two of the four were fixed and still filed as open.

| | count |
|---|---|
| whole programs compiled, run on the CPU and compared against node | 27 |
| methods agreeing with node, of those the sweep can call | 49 of 53 |
| **open bugs, each a failing test** | 8 |

## The two commands

```
coil test                    # the gate. MUST be green.
coil test --suite frontier   # the open bugs. RED, and that is the point.
```

The frontier suite's failures are the work queue -- see `AGENTS.md`. Each asserts the
answer node gives, so fixing a bug turns its test green and it then stays as the
regression test it already was.
